datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2014, classifying geographic units in Uganda into food insecurity phases. The spatial data represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions, with classifications standardized using the IPC scale and organized by collection date and scenario.
